headline: Palantir Stock Flirts With Oversold, Down Nearly 40% In 2026
summary: Palantir stock has fallen 40% from highs due to cyclical fears and AI disruption concerns. RSI indicates nearly oversold levels.

headline: Anduril Lands Major Army Deal After 10 Months Of Battlefield Testing
summary: Anduril Industries was chosen by the U.S. Army to run the common data baseline for its Next Generation Command and Control effort.
